emptyState.title: Connect your broker in 1 minute
emptyState.description: The fastest path is connecting Tinkoff via API: trades and positions sync automatically and stay up to date. Using a different broker? Upload a CSV / Excel report.

totalPnl.title: Total PnL
totalPnl.tooltip: Net profit or loss on all closed trades including commissions. The main indicator of financial performance.

winRate.title: Win Rate
winRate.tooltip: Percentage of profitable trades. Formula: (Profitable / Total) * 100. For trend strategies 30-40% is normal, for scalping >50%.

optimalF.title: Optimal f
optimalF.tooltip: Ralph Vince's model. Shows the optimal fraction of capital to risk per trade to maximize geometric growth of the account.

sqn.title: System Quality (SQN)
sqn.tooltip: System Quality Number (Van Tharp). Evaluates system quality. SQN = (Expectancy / StdDev) * sqrt(N). >2.0 — good, >3.0 — excellent.

zScore.title: Z-Score (Serial)
zScore.tooltip: Z-Score shows dependency between trades. > 1.96: Alternating. < -1.96: Trending. Near 0: Random.

profitFactor.title: Profit Factor
profitFactor.tooltip: Ratio of total profit to total loss. > 1.5 — good, > 2.0 — excellent. If < 1.0 — system is unprofitable.

rExpectancy.title: R-Expectancy
rExpectancy.tooltip: Expected value in R (risks). Shows how much you earn per dollar of risk. 0.5R means $50 profit per $100 risk.

recoveryFactor.title: Recovery Factor
recoveryFactor.tooltip: Recovery factor. Shows how quickly the system recovers from drawdowns. Higher is better. > 3.0 — excellent resilience.

totalRoi.title: ROI
totalRoi.tooltip: Return on Investment. Your actual return relative to your initial deposit. Calculated as: Net PnL / Deposit × 100%.

expectedGhpr.title: Expected GHPR
expectedGhpr.tooltip: Expected GHPR (Geometric Holding Period Return) when using Optimal f. Shows your system's potential: if 1.05, then +5% per trade with optimal capital management.

sortinoRatio.title: Sortino Ratio
sortinoRatio.tooltip: Sortino ratio. Unlike Sharpe, it only accounts for downside volatility. > 2.0 — excellent, > 1.0 — good.

maxDrawdown.title: Max Drawdown
maxDrawdown.tooltip: Maximum drawdown. Largest drop in capital from peak to trough. Critical risk indicator.

currentDrawdown.title: Current Drawdown
currentDrawdown.tooltip: Current drawdown from historical equity peak. If > 10% — consider reviewing risks.

tailRatio.title: Tail Ratio
tailRatio.tooltip: Ratio of extreme outcomes: top 10% profits to top 10% losses. > 1.0 — tails in your favor.

winStreak.title: Win Streak
winStreak.tooltip: Maximum consecutive winning trades. Helps assess system stability.

lossStreak.title: Loss Streak
lossStreak.tooltip: Maximum consecutive losing trades. Critical for trader psychology. > 5 — check your strategy.

avgWinLoss.title: Avg Win / Loss
avgWinLoss.tooltip: Average winning and losing trade. Win/Loss ratio should be > 1.5 for a stable system.

calmarRatio.title: Calmar Ratio
calmarRatio.tooltip: Calmar Ratio = Annual Return / Max Drawdown. Shows risk management efficiency. < 0.5 — poor, 1-2 — good, > 3 — top hedge fund level.

ror20.title: Risk of Ruin (20%)
ror20.tooltip: Probability of losing 20% of account. < 5% — excellent, > 20% — high risk of ruin.

ror50.title: Risk of Ruin (50%)
ror50.tooltip: Probability of losing half the account. Should be < 1% for conservative trading.

monteCarlo5.title: Monte Carlo 5th %
monteCarlo5.tooltip: 5th percentile of 1000 simulations. Worst expected outcome with 95% probability. Bootstrap analysis.

monteCarloMedian.title: Monte Carlo Median
monteCarloMedian.tooltip: Median result from 1000 simulations. Realistic expectation if current trading system is maintained.

rDistribution.title: Trades >1R
rDistribution.tooltip: Percent of trades where profit exceeded initial risk (stop-loss). >1R = earned more than risked. >2R = earned twice the risk. Shows ability to let winners run.

tradeDuration.title: Avg Trade Duration
tradeDuration.tooltip: Average time in trade. If you hold losses longer than profits — discipline problem.

bestDay.title: Best Day
bestDay.tooltip: Day of week with best total profit. Use to optimize trading schedule.

maeMfe.title: MAE (drawdown)
maeMfe.tooltip: MAE — max adverse excursion against position (%). MFE — max favorable movement (%). Efficiency — how much of MFE you capture on exit.
